first-delivery.name: First Delivery
first-delivery.brief: Deliver construction supplies to the lunar receiving depot. The depot accepts cargo only inside its marked reception zone and only after the capsule has braked to a safe relative speed.

supply-delivery.name: Supply Delivery
supply-delivery.brief: Deliver consumable supply packs to the lunar receiving depot. Lighter cargo gives more braking margin, but the order still needs the full quantity inside the marked reception zone.

precision-cargo.name: Precision Cargo
precision-cargo.brief: Deliver a ruggedized research module. The cargo tolerates a lower launch load and a much stricter arrival speed than construction supplies. High reward, narrow margin.
